1.
Heard Ms. R. D. Mozumdar, learned counsel for the appellant.

Also heard Mr. R. Goswami,
learned counsel for the respondent No. 1/claimant.

2. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the Oriental Insurance Company Limited impugning the judgment and order dated 12.12.2025, passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 3, Kamrup(M), Guwahati, in MAC Case No. 2597/2019 whereby the appellant was directed to pay an compensation amount of Rs.13,23,840/- along with an interest at the rate of 9% per annum to the claimant/respondent No. 1.
3.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: I have perused the grounds stated in the memo of appeal and have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant.

5. Let the records of MAC Case No. 2597/2019 be called for from the concerned tribunal.
6.
The Registry shall take steps for requisitioning the records.
Since, Mr. R. Goswami, learned counsel has already appeared for the respondent No. 1, no formal notice need to be issued to the said respondent.
9. However, a copy of the memo of appeal along with annexures shall be furnished to the learned counsel for the respondent No. 1 within a week from Page No.# 3/3 the date of this order.

10. As regards other respondents, the appellant shall take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual mode within seven working days from the date of this order, returnable 22 nd of May, 2026.
